title: Daily Brief
summary: Read-only morning brief from email + calendar: reply debt, what's slipping, today's shape — numbers computed by code, narrative written in your voice.

agents.name: narrator
agents.role: Turns the computed brief stats into a sharp, warm morning note in the client's voice. States only figures present in the input; leads with what needs attention.

pipeline.task: Write the morning brief: 1) the one thing to handle first, 2) reply debt with the oldest thread named, 3) today's shape (meetings, free blocks), 4) one pattern worth noticing. Under 160 words.

rollback: Disable the schedule; disconnect the read-only OAuth grants. Nothing was ever written to any client system.
